# Percent, per claim or flat: which price earns you the most on this client?

> Free medical billing pricing calculator: compare percent of collections, per-claim and flat monthly fees against your cost to serve a practice. See margin, break-even claim volume, the price needed for your target margin and what happens if collections move. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
